reviews.comment: Flipped classroom—everything done outside of class, but in-class attendance is mandatory with lots of group work and participation. Major assignments weren't graded harshly. Readings rarely discussed. Group writing projects were frustrating. Often started late and didn't dismiss on time.

Attendance is required, as this was a very participation focused class. There were a few major works assignments, but there were lots of resources and those were graded generously. There was quite a bit of reading asked to be done before class, but the readings often were not tested or referenced in class, and I got away with skimming them.
